# Pako 2.1.0

Unmodified browser inflate-only bundle downloaded from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodeca/pako/2.1.0/dist/pako_inflate.min.js

Upstream: https://github.com/nodeca/pako/tree/2.1.0

MIT license for the wrapper; zlib license for the underlying compression code.
Both notices are included here and embedded in the national offline HTML.
The application uses `pako.ungzip(bytes, {to: 'string'})` to read embedded roads.
